blocks.text: The Porter Chest of Drawers helps you keep your room feeling calm and put together with five smooth‑operating drawers that sort clothes, linens and seasonal pieces with ease. Its traditional design, hand‑finished details and bun feet create a dresser for bedroom spaces that feels warm and grounded. Felt lining in the top drawer protects delicate items while cedar‑lined bottoms help keep fabrics fresh. Antiqued dark bronze‑tone hardware completes this wooden dresser, giving your space a functional storage dresser that works in small or larger rooms.
